note: Recast from the original description of Emerson 1952, in English; the alate and the soldier are both fully described, with measurement tables. The measurements are taken from tables 1 and 2 of the original, which uses millimetres throughout for units below 1 foot, and are copied here as given. In the OCR "pl." is misread as "pi."; corrected by sense.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head, pronotum and abdominal tergites dark brown, the clypeus and pronotum slightly paler than the head, the fontanelle plate dark; the pronotum bears a series of Y-shaped pale spots. The wing membrane is whitish in the specimens and contrasts strongly with the colour of the wing scales; wing scales, costa and radius dark brown; tibiae dark except at both ends, in strong contrast with the pale yellow femora and tarsi. The lateral corners of the soldier labrum are distinctly more acute than a right angle, and within the genus only the soldier of triacifer agrees, but in triacifer the lateral corners are even more acute.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdominal tergites dark brown, the clypeus and pronotum slightly paler than the head, the fontanelle plate dark, the pronotum with a series of Y-shaped pale spots, the sternites paler than the tergites; wing membrane white and unlike the colour of the wing scales (the specimens may be immature; in mature individuals the membrane may be hyaline); wing scales, costa and radius dark brown, the tibiae dark except at both ends, the femora and tarsi pale yellow. Y suture not visible. Fontanelle plate large, oval, slightly depressed. Compound eyes rather small, their lower margin about one third of an eye width from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli small, smaller than the fontanelle plate, 0.05—0.16 mm from the compound eye, always more than their own length from it; antenna 15 segments. Posterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave. Fore tibia usually with 2 apical spurs, occasionally with an additional short spur on one side. Female measurements: head length to the tip of the clypeus 2.06—2.29, head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.59—1.65, head width 1.91—1.97, compound eye diameter 0.47, distance from the compound eye to the lower margin 0.16—0.21, ocellus length 0.14—0.18, width 0.09—0.13, ocellus to compound eye 0.23—0.29, ocellus to fontanelle plate 0.41—0.50, fontanelle plate length 0.18—0.23, width 0.17—0.22, pronotum length 0.88—0.93, width 1.71—1.79, hind tibia length 2.06—2.07, forewing length from the suture 18.24—18.42, width 4.51—4.89 mm (n=4—5); male head width 1.79—1.85, pronotum width 1.52—1.53, forewing length 17.11 mm (n=1—2). Compared with striatus, the tibiae of the latter are slightly darker than the femora, the head is narrower (1.57—1.75 mm) and the pronotum is also narrower (1.30—1.57 mm); compared with lespesii, the femora and tibiae of the latter are pale yellow, the head is narrower still (1.29—1.45 mm) and the pronotum 1.10—1.22 mm wide.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Abdominal tergites slightly paler yellow than the head and pronotum, the abdomen often greyish from the gut contents. Head, pronotum and abdominal tergites with scattered setae, especially sparse on the head, and with a few barely visible short hairs on the head and postmentum. Head fairly large and thick, the sides slightly curved or nearly straight, parallel or slightly converging anteriorly; posterior corners and posterior margin rounded. Frontal tube reaching the base of the postclypeus from above. The narrowest part of the postmentum is about seven ninths of the widest part (0.50 mm), the surface finely wrinkled. Antenna 15 segments. Lateral corners of the labrum distinct, slightly more acute than a right angle. Mandibles as in figure 7. Anterior margin of the pronotum hardly concave, or with only a very shallow notch. Measurements: head including mandibles 3.03—3.47, head length to the tip of the frontal tube 1.97—2.44, head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 2.10—2.59, head width 1.67—2.00, head thickness 1.32—1.59, frontal tube length 0.32—0.43, labrum width 0.57—0.69, left mandible length 1.14—1.32, right mandible length from the notch 0.68—0.76, pronotum length 0.50—0.59, width 0.76—1.06, hind tibia length 1.59—1.88 mm (n=6—38). Type locality São Paulo, São Paulo state, Brazil; the alates (morphotype and paratypes) and the soldiers (holotype and paratypes) were taken from the same nest.
